patch.summary: BookYourData migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to BookYourData by inventorying legacy sales-intelligence fields, mapping them to BookYourData objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating critical integrations before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: No native email sequencing or multichannel engagement — outreach has to run in a separate tool
Success signal: contact management works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: BookYourData migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power contact management, lead scoring and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into BookYourData; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate primary integrations; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Outbound and recruiting teams that buy verified contacts in bursts rather than on a monthly data subscription outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: No native email sequencing or multichannel engagement — outreach has to run in a separate tool
If BookYourData mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Apollo.io before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire systems of record in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: No native email sequencing or multichannel engagement — outreach has to run in a separate tool

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Reporting is limited to credit and list operations, with no campaign or conversion analytics

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Dollar credit-pack tiers were not confirmed from live first-party pricing HTML in this research pass

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for contact management
Mitigate: No native email sequencing or multichannel engagement — outreach has to run in a separate tool
